reviews.text: A few days ago, I took my cat to the vet. He fell twice from 6 meters, fortunately without serious consequences. Dr. Raffaella (who isn't particularly forthcoming, I'd say) was very good at handling the situation, and the other vet working with her was also excellent. My cat was thoroughly examined with all the necessary tests, and I have to say the price was quite reasonable: €118. For all the things they did to the cat, the doctors weren't at all venal. Highly recommended.
Qualified staff and animal-loving doctors, sweet and plus good prices I recommend everyone to become their customers.
I went there for an X-ray on my puppy. Qualified and courteous staff, low prices. I recommend it to everyone 😉 …

Truly terrible vet. 9 years ago, she was good, but then she lost her way. They're just money-grubbers and, above all, rude!
They paid 50 euros for two checkups in one week, and they didn't even notice that my dog ​​had a lump, a tumor right under her udder. They do everything except a checkup. My advice to you is to shut down your practice. You're not capable of running a practice!
Trust professionals, don't look at proximity or price!!!
Very professional but above all very humane with the animals that suffer and lovingly care for the foundlings.

We've been relying on you for years and years.
Now my bunny is your patient.
Thank you for your kindness.

It's a great place, friendly, competent, clean, but a bit small and pets can't stay overnight if they are sick, even parking is a problem that locals go for, but for these small limitations it's still worth going.
